method.order: AB, BA per runtime; case order alternates by pair; one build per fresh process
method.timed: Compile one predicate and scan every index per repetition; accumulate and check index-weighted checksums after timing
method.excluded: Data generation, collection construction, per-row oracle checks and shared-memory digests
method.estimate: Per-process medians, paired after/before ratios, geometric mean; primary/control deterministic 10000-resample percentile bootstrap over whole process pairs
